sources.snippet: Sat 12l Sm is a versatile open-weight language model developed by Segment Any Text. Built on modern Transformer architecture with Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) and Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE), Sat 12l Sm delivers strong performance in instruction following, multi-turn dialogue, creative synthesis, and structured JSON output generation.
